purpose: Define the research candidate contract without constructing or tuning a Signal.

evidence_inheritance.source_matrix: PR #109 independence-adjusted feature stability matrix v1
evidence_inheritance.independence_note: The 14 nominal winners are not treated as 14 independent confirmations; temporal fold is the independence unit.

candidate_contract.outcome_boundary: Frozen prior evidence boundary; no outcome redefinition in this stage.
candidate_contract.time_ordering: All candidate inputs must be computed using information available at or before the candidate timestamp.
candidate_contract.embargo: Retain the one-observation outcome separation used by E1.
candidate_contract.cost_boundary: Use the frozen prior cost boundary only; do not optimize it here.
candidate_contract.parameter_policy: No numeric threshold selection, tuning, fitting, or reinvestment in candidate_definition.
candidate_contract.execution_policy: Analysis/signal-only; no order generation or live execution.
candidate_contract.evaluation_policy: Candidate definition must be evaluated on temporally separated evidence; no random shuffle or cross-fold leakage.
rejection_conditions: Any feature uses future outcome information.
Any candidate parameter is selected from the evaluation fold.
Any overlap with the frozen boundary is detected.

next_gate: Candidate-definition review first; threshold tuning remains explicitly blocked.
